# Sparse celestial wallpaper

Created with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-09-07, using v1 as a style reference.
Asset: celestial-drawn-background-v2.png (1024 x 1536).

Final edit prompt: Keep exactly three complete hand-drawn planets (Saturn, Earth,
Jupiter) and a few widely spaced small stars. Preserve the blue and gold pencil
engraving style. Keep all motifs fully inside the canvas, with a clear 100-pixel
border. Use an opaque solid white background, no checkerboard, paper grain,
gradients or extra objects. No drawings may touch or cross the outer border.

The page renders this art on a separate noninteractive background layer. Both
tile axes have matching repeated edge masks, so each empty boundary fades into
the solid page background instead of forming a visible rectangular join.
